title: Battlefield 6 joins Game Pass on October 13 🎮
subject: battlefield6
description:
Will you finally try it on Game Pass? 👇

Xbox confirmed on October 7, 2026 that Battlefield 6 joins Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on October 13, playable on Xbox Series X|S, PC and cloud. EA's shooter launched October 10, 2025, sold over 7 million copies in 3 days, the series' biggest launch, and was the best-selling game of 2025 in the US.

Sources: Xbox Wire via Insider Gaming (Oct 7, 2026), Pure Xbox (Oct 7, 2026), TwistedVoxel (Oct 7, 2026), EA via Push Square (Oct 16, 2025), Circana via GameSpot (Jan 22, 2026)
Game footage © Electronic Arts.
